title: Cerebro Upgrade State
description: Baseline record written after each successful /cerebro-upgrade run. Drives accurate change detection on the next upgrade.

applied_ref.description: The git tag or commit SHA that was passed to /cerebro-upgrade

applied_sha.description: Full 40-character SHA of the upstream commit that was applied

applied_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the upgrade was applied

hashes.description: Map of relative file path to SHA-256 hex digest of committed content at time of upgrade. Covers all template-owned and merge-owned files present in the local tree after the upgrade.

additionalProperties.description: SHA-256 hex digest (64 lowercase hex characters)
